senses.definition: n.pr.loc. (place of the depression) reckoned to Judah Jos 15:6, 61, to Benjamin 18:22 = הָֽעֲרָבָה 18:18, הָֽעֲרָבָ֑תָה v 18; cf. also adj.gent. הָֽעַרְבָתִי 2 S 23:31 (perhaps read בֵּית־הָֽע׳ Klo cf. Dr) = 1 Ch 11:32;—site unknown.
